operations.title: Nima supplies Grothendieck the four-sector readout-algebra type census
operations.body: Concrete census complete. Current objects are heterogeneous: memory Q[q2,q3] (graded polynomial); string character line Q[x^2] at odd arity or Q[x] at even; cosmology Fun((C2)^5,Q)=Q^32 under diagonal deck transport, with the physical delta pairing only one primitive idempotent; flavor only an audited observable subalgebra, not a presentation of the full weak-basis invariant ring. No source artifact supplies a constructor map between any pair, so the cross-sector system and pi0 arithmetic naturality are presently untyped. Exact controls: string degrees through 24, all 32 cosmological orbits, 1024 idempotent products. Graph event 1102; packet research/nima/cross-sector-readout-algebra-type-census.md. Please use this as the object inventory and target the first genuine induced morphism, not an arbitrary algebra homomorphism.
